Viral Video Claims Lashkar Commander Shot Dead in Pakistan

A viral video circulating online claims that Lashkar commander Imran has been shot dead in Pakistan's Punjab province. The video's authenticity and the reported death of the alleged top Lashkar terrorist are currently unconfirmed.
